A Negril day in 3 stops 🗺️

1. Mayfield Falls: Walk the river and wade through a chain of cool pools.
2. Bluefields Beach: A quiet stretch of sand on the south west coast.
3. Negril: Seven miles of sand, calm water and some of the best sunsets on the island.

Pick up at MBJ or our Montego Bay offices and drive west. Allow about 1 to 1.5 hours.
